goal: Implement the local qualification and keyless DSH stage of a pinned SkillsBench geometry pilot without enabling paid execution.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Lock and verify selected upstream files, preserve private verifier separation, and reject source drift and unsafe paths.
Both selected oracle solutions pass and no-op controls fail ordinary assertions in offline containers; setup errors and skips cannot qualify a task.
Actual headless DSH executes the keyless shell probe with exact selected skill bytes and no provider key.
Reject paid options, retain existing paid budgets, bound outputs and document the remaining live integration without claiming improvement.

outcome.summary: Local qualification and keyless DSH stage implemented and verified. The broader paid adaptation pilot is not complete: live manifest/receipt wiring, budget extension and non-tau adaptation eligibility remain. No paid model call or improvement claim.

what_worked: Selected a CPU-only geometry export development/transfer pair after excluding tasks with visible grading defects.
Both upstream oracle and no-op controls produced the expected independent outcomes.
Reused the existing native gateway and headless DSH runtime for shell and skill-byte protocol proof.
Full verification passed with 928 tests passing and 7 opt-in tests skipped.
what_failed: A raw local image ID was not a usable Docker FROM reference; the builder now resolves it through a digest-derived tag and verifies its identity.
Review found verifier setup errors could count as no-op failure; qualification now requires the complete three-test JUnit report with no errors or skips.
An existing gateway timeout-status test failed once under concurrent load, then passed alone and in a complete rerun without edits; timing sensitivity remains.
Fresh dependency builds are not guaranteed byte-identical; subsequent trials use a pinned built image.

calls.name: pilot fetch and build
calls.purpose: Verify pinned public task sources and build the isolated local runtime.

calls.name: pilot qualify
calls.purpose: Run separate offline oracle and no-op controls for both selected tasks.

calls.name: pilot rehearse
calls.purpose: Prove native DSH shell execution and selected skill identity without a model provider.

calls.name: pnpm run check
calls.purpose: Verify focused changes and repository gates.

evidence.summary: 132 focused tests passed. Full typecheck, build, 48 test files, capsule, policy and offline evaluation gates passed on final run; diff whitespace validation passed.
Both geometry tasks: oracle passed, no-op failed, exactly three tests, no verifier setup errors or skips. Not a model evaluation.
Headless DSH completed the fixed shell probe and matched selected Markdown bytes; supporting skills were read-only. No task solution or adaptive gain claimed.
Documents immutable upstream selection, local-runtime differences, audit exclusions, limitations and remaining paid integration. Raw upstream files and runtime artifacts stay local.

notes: Review local implementation before adding exact paid task manifests and extending the budget. No new paid approval or production activation is implied.
